correctness.rationale: The corrected fourth-power objective is coercive and strictly convex on unrestricted complex coefficients. Uniqueness with conjugation and residual reversal forces a-b=1. Independently squaring the residual and applying Parseval gives c_0=s^2, c_d=-2st+(d-1)t^2 for 1<=d<=n, c_(n+1)=2s^2+nt^2, and the reflected coefficients. Exact summation and symbolic differentiation reproduce all four integer coefficients of the cubic. The endpoint derivative signs hold for every n>=1; since P'(c)=48(c-3/4)^2+9>0, derivative bracketing yields nt_n -> c_* and n(omega_n-1) -> 2c_*.
